title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
note: Three branches (compressed/selected/window) + learned gates; selection reuses compression scores; LongBench 0.469 vs 0.437 full; AIME NSA-R 0.121/0.146 vs 0.046/0.092; 9.0x/6.0x fwd/bwd at 64k (Triton, A100).

title: Quest: Query-Aware Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
note: Per-page channel-wise min/max bound sum_d max(q*m,q*M); page 16; 4096-token budget; first two layers kept dense; GQA union inflates budget.

title: MInference 1.0: Accelerating Pre-filling via Dynamic Sparse Attention
note: A-shape / vertical-slash / block-sparse heads; last-64-query estimator; pooled block scores (pooling and matmul commute); 10x prefill at 1M (30min->3min); 96.8% sparsity at 128k; top-4k columns = 96.8% mass.

title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
note: Strided antidiagonal sums (stride 4, 1/4 of block entries) as block-importance proxy; softmax over block scores then cumulative threshold 0.9/0.95 with per-head thresholds by offline DP; up to 13.5x attention speedup; strongest evidence in video (VBench PSNR 23.5, SSIM 0.822, >50% sparsity).

title: FlexPrefill: A Context-Aware Sparse Attention Mechanism
note: Representative last-block probe; JS divergence decides structured (alpha 0.95) vs query-aware (alpha 0.9); cumulative-attention index selection; most heads resolve to the structured regime.

title: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
note: Gate = q . mean(K_block), top-k blocks, current block always routed with causal mask; Llama-8B-1M-MoBA with block 4096, top-12, 100B tokens of continual pretraining: RULER 0.7818 vs full 0.7849.

title: H2O: Heavy-Hitter Oracle for Efficient Generative Inference
note: Accumulated attention mass as token importance; keep heavy hitters + recent; canonical eviction baseline.

title: SnapKV: LLM Knows What You are Looking for Before Generation
note: Prefill-time compaction from an observation window of the last queries, average-pooled over keys (kernel 7 for Llama-3); observation window always retained.

title: PyramidKV: Dynamic KV Cache Compression based on Pyramidal Information Funneling
note: Depth-dependent budget on top of SnapKV: wide early layers, narrow late layers.

title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
note: Uniform random eviction (prompt + recent window kept) matches the strongest tuned selector across 4 models / 6 reasoning tasks with 32-43% higher vLLM throughput; the gap between selectors is explained by whether they kept the prompt.

title: COBS: Cumulant Order Block Sparse Attention
note: Formalises block selection as ranking blocks by attention mass; if selection were exact, block-sparse matches dense. Block sparse is not prevalent among leading open-weight LLMs, which use dense or fine-grained selection.

title: StreamIndex: Memory-Bounded Compressed Sparse Attention via Streaming Top-k
note: Naive CSA materialises [B,S,H_I,T] fp32 scores: 256 GB at S=65536 with V4-Flash dims (OOM on H200). Chunked partition-merge top-k Triton driver avoids it.

title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
note: Three orthogonal indexer optimisations (streaming-aware layout, cross-layer reuse, hierarchical coarse-to-fine); scaled 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B on par with full attention.

title: IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse
note: DSA top-k selections are highly similar across adjacent layers; Full layers run indexers, Shared layers reuse the nearest Full layer's indices; training-free greedy search minimising calibration loss, plus a training-aware variant.

title: SPIN: Shadow Predictive Indexer for Sparse Attention
note: History-based prediction replaces full-cache scoring; 30-40% sparsity, +14.9% output throughput, -13.2% median inter-token latency in vLLM; treats speculative decoding as first-class.

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
note: CSA2 = cross-layer KV reuse + compressed sparse attention; FP4 KV; 890 bytes/token global KV (~1/4 of V4-Flash); causal encoder-decoder with 16B active on decode / 8B on prefill; 1M context; 552B backbone.

title: HN: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash release thread
note: 1,016 points, 574 comments. Discussion centers on the 552B backbone, 890 B/token KV claim, local deployment, cache-hit economics, and benchmark skepticism; no independent layerwise CSA2 quality ablation.

title: HN: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017
note: 957 points, 718 comments. Continues deployment-cost, cache-pricing and benchmark-trust discussion for the updated checkpoint.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2 (with DSA lightning indexer)
note: MLA core + DSA: indexer score sum_j w_j ReLU(q_j . k_s), top-2048 tokens per query, then MLA over the selection. The V3.2-Exp release (2025-09) shipped the mechanism first.

title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
note: KDA = channel-wise decay + delta rule with a specialised DPLR chunkwise kernel; 3:1 KDA:MLA hybrid; 1.4T tokens; beats full MLA (MMLU-Pro 51.0 vs 47.2, RULER-128k 84.3 vs 81.3); KV -75%; TPOT at 1M 1.84ms vs 11.48ms; open KDA kernel + vLLM integration.

title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
note: 2.8T MoE (104B activated), 1M context, built on KDA + attention residuals; ~2.5x scaling efficiency over K2; explicitly credits algorithm-system co-design for KDA; million-token agentic RL.

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
note: Splits the scalar gate into channel-wise erase and write gates; recovers KDA when they collapse; chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors.

title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
note: Adds the delta-rule erase to Mamba-2-style gated decay; chunkwise WY/UT transform makes it trainable at scale.

title: Transformers are SSMs: Structured State Space Duality
note: The chunked semiseparable (SSD) algorithm: intra-chunk quadratic + inter-chunk state, which is the shape every later chunked linear-attention kernel reuses.

title: DeepSeek-V2 (Multi-head Latent Attention)
note: Cache one latent per token, materialise per-head K/V inside the kernel; the compressed-feature baseline that DSA and CSA build on.

title: SeerAttention-R: Sparse Attention Adaptation for Long Reasoning
note: Learned block-pool gate (pool q/k in blocks, small projection, sigmoid, learned threshold) adapted for long reasoning decodes; requires training, unlike Quest/MInference.

title: SAS: Simple Attention Sparsification via End-to-End Optimization of Context Ranking
note: Selector training by distilling dense attention distributions optimises the wrong objective (attention weights rather than prediction under a fixed budget); proposes end-to-end optimisation of the ranking.

title: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
note: Sliding-window branch + long-range keypoint-cell selection; FS-L prunes the prefix with short CPT for linear time, FS-B uses balanced trees (N log^2 N) for better zero-shot length extrapolation.

title: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
note: 456B/45.9B lightning (linear) attention at scale with a 7:1 linear:softmax interleave - the earliest large-scale hybrid deployment.

title: Broken Symmetry in BF16 Attention: Why FlashAttention Gradients Blow Up Late in Training
note: Reproduces gradient blow-ups when pretraining a 450M model with FlashAttention-3 in bf16; kernel numerics are a model-quality concern, not only a systems concern.

title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
note: Low-bit quantisation of GDN/KDA recurrent state; part of the 2026 compression trend (FP4 KV, quantised state) that composes with selection.

title: HySparse2: Hybrid Sparse Attention with Two-Level KV Sharing
note: Targets long-horizon agents generating short actions against long tool observations; two-level KV sharing for prefill efficiency and cache compaction.

title: HN: DeepSeek-v3.2 release thread (982 points, 465 comments)
note: Practitioner concerns in order: local-runnability at long context (KV footprint), token inflation of the deepest reasoning variant (50% more tokens; 3.5x Gemini 3 on one Codeforces comparison), benchmark-vs-vibe skepticism.

title: HN: Kimi Linear thread (306 points)
note: Practitioner questions focus on hubris of linear attention on long-context retrieval (needle/RULER) vs the reported efficiency; commenters point to K3 and Gated DeltaNet-2 as follow-ons.

title: HN: A walk through the DeltaNet family of linear attention variants (297 points, 126 comments)
note: Community explainer for the GDN/KDA family; the most-viewed technical discussion of compressed-state attention of 2026.

title: HN: LRU is harder to beat than the KV-cache papers suggest (108 points)
note: Measured on 393 real Claude Code sessions: requests after a gap longer than the provider TTL are 17.5% of recompute; three non-LRU policies all lost to plain radix-leaf LRU. Bounds what attention-level optimisations can buy when cache reuse dominates.

title: More Value per Key: Asymmetric Sparse Attention for Faster LLM Decoding
note: SAGA/Atop-N decouples key and value head counts; >2x long-context decode speedup. NeurIPS 2026.

title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
note: Pyramid Top-K routing over hierarchical key summaries; O(N log N) selection. Preprint 2026.

title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
note: Shared low-rank QK subspace for token ranking and a gather-free selection kernel. Preprint 2026.

title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
note: Scores sparse units by reduction in A V error rather than attention mass. Preprint 2026.

title: OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval
note: Page-local spectral bases from centred key-value coupling; report +3.7-3.9 avg@k over FreeKV. Preprint 2026.

title: Scaling Attention via Feature Sparsity
note: Sparse feature codes keep all tokens and reduce FLOPs/KV by about 50% at matched quality. ICLR 2026.

title: DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction
note: Output-perturbation eviction with a fused Triton scorer; 19.8x scoring speedup. NeurIPS 2026.

title: ReST-KV: Robust KV Cache Eviction with Layer-wise Output Reconstruction and Spatial-Temporal Smoothing
note: Reconstruction-based eviction with temporal/spatial smoothing; +15.2 RULER in the paper. ICLR 2026.

title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
note: Keeps query-cluster representatives for thought-revisiting queries; up to 5.8x memory reduction. ICML 2026.

title: Q-Delta: Beyond Key-Value Associative State Evolution
note: Query-conditioned prediction becomes a correction signal in the delta rule. ICML 2026.

title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
note: Diagonal and isotropic Kalman-gain variants of delta-rule memory. Preprint 2026.

title: Switching Linear Attention
note: Mixture of linear regressors trained by online EM; fixed-size state but nonlinear routing. COLM 2026.
